wave: Wave 15 — SOTA-Driven Constructive Improvements (AES-256, McEliece-348864, Dynamic QROM)

previous_design.architecture: K=4 Sub-Pipelined Out-of-Place Boyar-Peralta S-Box (22Q scratch/S-Box)
previous_design.bottleneck: Reusing 22Q Boyar-Peralta AND scratch across 4 columns incurred 1.75x intra-round uncomputation penalty (952 vs 544 ANDs/round) and 4x serial column depth.

published_sota_reference.citations: Zou et al. [2020, Asiacrypt] (400 Q, 52K Toffolis); Huang & Sun [2022, Asiacrypt] (376 Q, 48K Toffolis, 1.5x depth)

improved_design.architecture: Self-Cleaning Tower-Field F_{2^4}^2 S-Box (4Q-6Q internal ancillas) + In-Place Rolling Key Schedule + Sequential Dual-Plaintext Match + Key-State Column Zipper
improved_design.zero_free_lunch_verification: Norm ancillas (4Q-6Q) are uncomputed inside each 38-40 Toffoli S-Box before moving to the next byte; rolling key W_i ^= SubWord(RotWord(W_{i-1})) is inverted in-place from intact W_{i-1}; Pair 1 is fully uncomputed after flipping 1Q match flag |m_1> before Pair 2 reuses the 128Q state.

sota_improvements_table.target: Classic McEliece-348864 (n=3488, k=2720, r=768, w=64) & BIKE-L1 ISD

previous_design.architecture: QDS-7 Full 768x768 Quantum Gaussian Elimination (Bruhat LU / One-Way Pivot-XOR)
previous_design.bottleneck: Storing and inverting an r x r = 768 x 768 binary submatrix in superposition requires 768^2 = 589,824 matrix qubits + 294,528 pivot-history ancillas.

published_sota_reference.citations: Esser, May, Zweydinger [2022, Eurocrypt] (~14,500 Q Streaming Lee-Brickell / Stern ISD); Perriello et al. [2023] (590,592 Q Prange ISD)

improved_design.architecture: Esser-May-Zweydinger [2022] Streaming Syndrome Accumulator + Classical Select-SWAP (QROAM, B=8) + QDS-2 Braun Weight Tree
improved_design.register_breakdown: 768Q (64x12b error indices) + 768Q (syndrome accumulator) + 6,144Q (B=8 x 768b QROAM buffer) + 64Q (Braun weight tree)
improved_design.zero_free_lunch_verification: Parity-check matrix H in F_2^{768 x 3488} is 100% CLASSICAL (public key), so Select-SWAP (QROAM) has ZERO Catch-4 quantum-table entanglement penalty. Outer-loop Grover iteration tradeoff vs Prange ISD is explicitly accounted per Esser et al. [2022].

sota_improvements_table.target: Dynamic Quantum Superposition Tables (Zhandry [2019] Compressed Oracle / Kuperberg Sieve, Q=1024, w=512)

previous_design.architecture: Per-Query Sequential O(q*w) Linear-Scan CSWAP Insertion
previous_design.bottleneck: Scanning and CSWAP-sorting all q active slots on each query costs sum_{q=1}^Q 2*q*w = Q(Q+1)w = 537.4M Toffolis.

published_sota_reference.citations: Bernstein [2009] / Childs-Jao-Soukharev [2014] / Jaques-Schanck [2019] Quantum Sorting Networks; Bentley-Saxe [1980] Logarithmic Method

improved_design.architecture_batched: Reversible Batcher Bitonic / Odd-Even Merge Sorting Network (55 parallel stages)
improved_design.architecture_sequential_online: Okasaki Binomial / Bentley-Saxe Power-of-Two Level-Sorted Runs (L_0..L_9)
improved_design.zero_free_lunch_verification: Uses ONLY standard CCX and CSWAP gates (0 hardware QRAM). Comparator direction bits are stored in 14,080 ancillas during the forward sort and uncomputed in reverse once the phase/collimation check completes.
